criteria.requirement: Repair tail(n, seq) so n=0 returns an empty result of the normal slice type for sliceable inputs and an empty tuple for iterator inputs without reading them. Reject negative index-protocol counts consistently with ValueError before consuming input. Preserve positive tail, last, index-protocol integers, top-level/curried/tlz APIs and all frozen tests. Do not eagerly materialize input or special-case the public example.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
